categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: ST0x Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized public equities and capital market instruments issued on the st0x.io platform.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Quantum-Resistant
categories.content: Quantum-resistant projects are characterised by their use of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (e.g., hash-based, lattice-based) to remain secure against potential attacks from future quantum computers.

categories.name: Zero Knowledge (ZK)
categories.content:
Zero-knowledge proof or Zero-knowledge protocol is a method by which one party (the prover) can prove to another party (the verifier) that a given statement is true while the prover avoids conveying any additional information apart from the fact that the statement is indeed true.

This category tracks cryptocurrency that utilises Zero Knowledge implementation to execute transactions, which may include smart contract execution, value transfer, and others.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: Dex Aggregator
categories.content: A DEX aggregator is designed to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of cryptocurrency trading. It searches across multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXs) to combine their liquidity, helping users avoid slippage on large orders, lower trading fees, and secure the best prices for tokens.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Cat-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by cat.

categories.name: Privacy Coins
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies designed primarily to function as digital cash or a store of value. Their architecture prioritizes the anonymity of the sender, receiver, and amount. They do not support general-purpose smart contracts or a dApp ecosystem.

categories.name: Bittensor Subnets
categories.content: Subnets on Bittensor are specialized mini-networks dedicated to specific AI tasks. In each subnet, models (miners) compete to produce high-quality outputs, and their performance is evaluated by validators who assign rankings and allocate TAO rewards accordingly.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem
categories.content: BagsApp Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via bags.fm.

categories.name: Data Availability
categories.content: Data availability on the blockchain ensures that all participants have the transaction data needed to verify blocks, even with resource limitations and scalability needs. Without it, independent verification crumbles, compromising the entire system. Data availability centric protocols aim to allow nodes to verify data availability more efficiently.

categories.name: Commodities Meme
categories.content: Meme projects tied to commodities in traditional finance.

categories.name: Modular Blockchain
categories.content: A modular blockchain is a type of blockchain architecture that separates the core functions of a blockchain into distinct modules or layers. Each module is designed to handle specific tasks independently.

categories.name: Privacy
categories.content: Privacy category showcases all cryptocurrencies, blockchain networks, and infrastructure protocols designed to protect user anonymity and secure data.

categories.name: Chain Abstraction
categories.content: Chain abstraction is the concept of creating a seamless, unified user experience across multiple blockchains, allowing users and developers to interact with different chains without needing to manually bridge assets, switch networks, or handle chain-specific complexities.
